meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作短动态图形视频，如动效文字、数据动画、品牌标识动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成10秒内的动态图形视频，无需旁白或真人出镜
copy.tagline_en: Create short motion graphics like kinetic typography, data animations, and brand stings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce under-10s motion graphics without narration or live action

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能根据你的需求自动生成一段短的运动图形视频（如动态文字、数据统计动画、Logo出场等），最终输出MP4文件。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一段短的运动图形视频，例如“创建一个动态文字动画”或“制作一个数据统计动画”时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个公司Logo的出场动画。
将这条新闻标题做成动态文字视频。
say.note: Claude会搜索新闻并制作动画。

say.text: 用这组数据生成一个柱状图动画。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can automatically generate a short motion graphic video (e.g., kinetic typography, data animation, logo sting) based on your request, outputting MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short motion graphic, such as 'create a kinetic typography animation' or 'make a data visualization animation'.

say_en.text: Make a logo reveal animation for my company.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the logo animation and output MP4.

say_en.text: Turn this news headline into kinetic typography.
say_en.note: Claude will search for the article and produce the animation.

say_en.text: Generate a bar chart animation from this data.
say_en.note: Claude will design the data visualization.
